set.pl: Marble Grove: J. S. Polk Est. strip on the ridge between Marble Lake and Spirit Lake, W part of sec. 17 T100N R36W (1911 atlas; Smith 1902)
pinev: J. S. Polk Est. shore strip and ridge road, W edge sec. 17 T100N R36W, 1911 Dickinson atlas; Marble Place resort plat adjoining; cabin not drawn. Set on land in the wooded grove on the ridge east of Marble Lake (1930 ortho, 2020 Iowa lidar); BLM PLSS has no section polygons here (meandered lots), so the sec. 17 position follows the atlas and the sec. 20 north line at 43.4739.

src: Atlas of Dickinson County, Iowa (1911), fractional T100N R36W plate
